thread:
Ria: Quick sync — we need to lock telemetry thresholds + SLA language for the console observability deliverables this sprint (dashboards, trace hooks, cost breakdown, error analytics). Can we agree acceptance criteria by EOD?
Alex: +1. Happy to propose concrete numbers. Do we want per-route cost SLOs or just surfaceable alerts?
Sam: For trace hooks, acceptance should include deterministic sampling config, a failing test that shows traces for a high-error route, and <50ms overhead at 95p for hook eval.
Jordan: From SRE side: any telemetry that affects latency must be gated. We want a canary that compares p95 latency before/after for 30m window; if p95 regresses >5% rollback.
Maya: Customer ask: enterprise customers want per-customer and per-route cost breakdowns in the dashboard + CSV export. For GA we need at least 90% accuracy on attribution vs bill.
Lina: UX: dashboard should have a compact cost widget + link to expanded cost explorer. Acceptance: widget + drilldown + CSV. Mock uploaded: <https://figma.com/s/console-cost-widget>.
Alex: Proposed acceptance checklist (draft):
```
- Dashboards: cost widget + drilldown, export CSV, per-route tags, test data + basic perms
- Trace hooks: sampling toggle, hook def UI, one end-to-end test, perf regression test (p95 < +5%)
- Cost breakdown: per-route & per-customer attribution, weekly sampling verification job, export
- Error analytics: grouped error table, first-seen / last-seen, sample trace link, SLA alerts
```
Ria: Nice. We should also include rollout gating items: canary cohort size, guardrail metrics, and a regression alert threshold.
Jordan: Canary plan: 5% traffic for 24h, then 25% for 12h, then 100% if no regressions. Guardrails: p50/p95 latency, error rate, CPU on inference nodes, and token-cost delta.
Sam: For sampling, default strategy: 1% global, plus route-based override where customer-configured >0.1%. Need a test harness to simulate 10k req/min to validate batching effects.
Maya: CS asks that alert descriptions include suggested mitigation steps and links to support docs. Also need a toggle for customers to opt-out of cost-export in region X due to compliance.
Lina: UX acceptance: minimal hover state for cost widget showing last-7d delta, and inline link to export. If export is disabled by policy, show banner + tooltip.
Alex: API / config shape for trace hooks (draft):
```
POST /api/v1/trace-hooks
{
  "route": "/v1/generate",
  "sample_pct": 1.0,
  "customer_override": true,
  "hook_script": "..."
}
```
Acceptance: config validation, 400 on invalid, quick feedback in UI.
Jordan: Ops acceptance: events emitted to telemetry pipeline for every hook activation (sample_id, route, customer_id, reason). Retention 30d for events, sampling logs optional.
Ria: Litigation/compliance note: any per-customer cost export must honor KYC export rules — coordinate with Legal. Maya pls follow up.
Maya: Will do, tagging Legal this afternoon.
CI-bot: deploybot: canary deployed to staging at 1795551500 — tests running.
Alex: Perf tests to run: synthetic trace injections + tokenized payload sizes: small (64 tokens), med (512), long (2048). Must report p50/p95/p99 and CPU.
Sam: I'll add a perf harness job in infra repo and a dashboard panel. Metric names: obs.trace_hook.overhead_ms, obs.trace_hook.invocations.
Ria: Final acceptance criteria summary for PRD bullet (Ria to paste into doc):
- Dashboards: cost widget + drilldown + CSV export; per-route attribution >=90% accuracy; UX mock implemented; unit + e2e tests.
- Trace hooks: sampling toggle + UI; config validation + API; perf regression <+5% p95; canary rollout plan defined.
- Cost breakdown: per-customer & per-route view; weekly sampling verification job; export controls by policy.
- Error analytics: grouped error table + sample trace links; alert docs + mitigation steps; retention and privacy compliance checks.
Ria: Owners: Alex (dashboards + cost), Sam (trace hooks + perf), Jordan (canary + ops guardrails), Lina (UX), Maya (CS + compliance). Delivery: ship candidate to canary by Thu, GA decision next Tue.
Jordan: Logging gating: if canary observes CPU > 80% or p95 latency regresses >5% for >15m, automated rollback.
Alex: Noted. I'll add a small telemetry flag to disable cost attribution if we see token-cost delta > 20% vs baseline.
Sam: Quick question — do we want sample traces linked from error analytics to be full KV caches or redacted? Security prefers redacted by default.
Maya: Redacted by default, customer can request full via support/escalation with audit log.
Lina: UX note: show redaction badge + link to request full traces.
Ria: OK. Action items: Alex -> update PRD with checklist + API shapes; Sam -> perf harness + infra job; Jordan -> canary automation + rollback criteria; Maya -> legal/compliance check; Lina -> update Figma screens. Weekly check-in Friday 0900.
Alex: I'll have PRD update by EOD.
Sam: Perf job in a draft branch, will ping when ready.
Maya: Legal ping scheduled 2pm PT.
Lina: Pushed updated mock for cost widget, comments welcome.
Jordan: I'll add the canary runbook to runbook repo and wire alerting.
Ria: Thanks team. If no objections, I'll mark acceptance criteria in the PRD and start gating on those items. :thumbsup:
Maya: :thumbsup:
